purpose: Implement the adapter-neutral bounded transaction and compensation chassis required by REQ-SCOPE-090: persist an immutable plan and recovery evidence, require a recovery snapshot before mutation, execute ordered bounded steps, verify each postcondition, compensate changed steps in reverse order, and surface recovery-required truth instead of half-complete success.

lineage.outcome: A multi-step musical job either completes and verifies, fully compensates what it changed, or visibly requires recovery; an intermediate failure never becomes a fake completed action.
lineage.capability: Bounded multi-step transaction, durable recovery evidence and reverse compensation

n0te2_dependencies: CORE-01 durable SQLite and Activity chronology
CORE-03D ordered Recipe semantics as composition evidence
legacy_rejections: ephemeral step state that disappears after crash

completion_proof: plan rejects duplicate step IDs and unknown/forward dependencies
plan and steps are immutable and fingerprinted before mutation
recovery snapshot is required and bound to the exact transaction/operation before any step executes
successful steps execute in declared order and each postcondition must be satisfied before the next step
middle-step failure stops forward execution and compensates all changed compensatable steps in strict reverse order
compensation failure, ambiguous mutation, non-compensatable changed step, callback ambiguity or ambiguous final receipt produces RECOVERY_REQUIRED/UNKNOWN rather than success
safe pre-mutation snapshot/driver-contract failure records explicit failure with zero executed steps
step execution STARTED and compensation STARTED evidence is durably persisted before adapter callbacks so process interruption leaves exact recovery breadcrumbs
transaction plan/step/event history survives restart in the canonical profile database and normal Headquarters reopen validates its integrity
a registered/in-flight transaction cannot be blindly rerun; unresolved execution/compensation steps are surfaced for recovery review
whole-operation SUCCEEDED/FAILED/UNKNOWN and final receipts remain owned by CORE-04D OperationJournal rather than a competing transaction status store
transaction lifecycle is projected into canonical Activity chronology
coordinator and driver protocol contain no DAW/provider brand logic or concrete adapter implementation
next_selection_rule: After CORE-04F evidence, reconcile and perform a CORE-04 A-F closure audit against all mapped foundation requirements before inventing another CORE-04 increment. Compare any concrete remaining trust gap against preserved CORE-02 Success Memory and newly dependency-ready downstream work.
